sources.observation: Dark timber and white panels anchor the ground level, two gilded upper stories carry open balconies under sweeping cypress roofs, and the phoenix faces outward above the ridge.

limitations: Gilded screen panels, raised eave profiles, bracket rhythm and the phoenix finial use the exterior photographs and mapped roof heights. The pavilion interior and garden structures are outside the asset.
